species.real: Each of the hundred iron men was cast from Antony Gormley's own body, and the barnacles on them show how long each spends under the tide.
species.name: Ironwatch

dex.text: Stands on the sand staring out to sea and does not blink when the tide comes in over its head. Nobody has ever seen one move. Count them twice and you will get two different numbers.
dex.fact: On Crosby beach a hundred cast-iron figures, the artwork Another Place, stand spread along the shore gazing out to sea. They arrived in 2005, were allowed to stay for good in 2007, and the tide slowly dresses them in barnacles and seaweed.
